newsitem.title: EGYPT: Arafat in Cairo for peace talks with Mubarak.
newsitem.headline: Arafat in Cairo for peace talks with Mubarak.

text.p: Palestinian President Yasser Arafat will brief Egypt's Hosni Mubarak on Wednesday on the latest developments in his peace talks with Israel, officials at Arafat's residence in Cairo said.
Mubarak was meeting Jordanian Prime Minister Abdul-Karim al-Kabariti and the officials said he would later talk with Arafat, who arrived early on Wednesday.

Palestinian officials said it was the first time Arafat had flown directly over the Israeli-controlled border of the Palestinian-ruled Gaza Strip to Cairo. He usually crosses into Egypt by land and then takes a plane from there.

On Tuesday, Arafat met Jordan's King Hussein in the Palestinian-ruled West Bank. Palestinian officials have said the monarch was trying to arrange a meeting with Arafat, himself and Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.
Mubarak has said that he would not meet Netanyahu unless Israel honoured a peace pledge signed with the Palestinians and withdrew its troops from the West Bank town of Hebron.
Palestinian and Israeli negotiators have held talks for the past two weeks to try to overcome an impasse on the pullout, which has been delayed by Israeli security concerns.
The U.S.-backed negotiations resumed in the Egyptian Red Sea resort of Taba on Wednesday.
